name: Waria Roleplay
description:
Waria RP - Your City, Your Story!

Welcome to Waria RP, a Minecraft Bedrock roleplay server where you can create your own story and build your life in a living city!

🚗 Explore a New World - Discover a brand-new map designed to offer a fresh roleplay experience.

💼 Choose Your Path - Take on jobs, develop your career, and find your place in the city.

🏙️ Live Your Own Story - Meet other players, interact with the community, and create unique roleplay experiences.

🎭 Immersive Roleplay - Enjoy a deeper and more engaging RP experience in a server built around serious roleplay.

🛠️ Version 4 Is Here! - Waria RP is entering a new chapter with a redesigned map, reworked jobs, and major improvements to the roleplay experience.

Your city. Your choices. Your story.
